description: Official subscription plan (tier) schema for mock API + State Engine. Plan media is a separate domain — not covered by these mock APIs.
notes: A plan entry is the creator subscription tier (draft or published).
formValues holds the publish-wizard state (pricing, discounts, audience, schedule, etc.).
card is a derived TierCard view-model for the plan list UI.
selectedMediaOptions may appear inside formValues as checkbox selections only — there is no mock API for uploading or managing plan media assets.

hasMedia.description: Derived from formValues.selectedMediaOptions length. Not a media API.

formValues.description: Publish wizard persistable state (see SubscriptionTierPopup defaults).

selectedMediaOptions.description: UI checkbox values only — no media upload mock API.

card.description: Derived list-card payload for TierCard (settingsList mode).

GET /plans.description: List all plans. Optional query.status = published | draft.

PATCH /plans/detail.description: Edit/update a plan. Body must include id.

DELETE /plans/detail.description: Delete a plan by query.id or body.id.

outOfScope: Plan media upload / library / attach media APIs
